title: Data Analyst (12 month secondment/contract)
text: Data Analyst (12 month secondment/contract) at Commonwealth Bank - Risk Management (Sydney, CBD, Inner West & Eastern Suburbs; Contract/Temp; salary: not stated). We are seeking the expertise of a Data Analyst join our Culture and Conduct team, for a 12 month fixed term contract/secondment. Culture and Conduct (including the implementation of the Banking Executive Accountability Regime) is a key area of focus of CBA's senior management and Board. The Group wide approach is developing and as such, this role is a new role in a challenging area of public, community and regulatory expectations that is critical to aligning are business to fair customer outcomes and the protection of market integrity which is critical to our long term success. As a data analyst within our team, you will design and implement the quarterly Business Unit and Group Culture and Conduct reporting within their respective governance structures. Your core responsibility will be to identify culture and conduct related data and pull that data together into a designed template for each Business Unit to enable Business Unit Leadership Teams to identify underlying culture and conduct risks and appropriate escalations and actions to be taken. If you have demonstrated data analytical and technical skills gained within a financial services environment, and the drive and initiative to deliver high quality work focusing on "right first time" accurate analysis, we would love to hear from you. Your individuality is welcomed and openly encouraged in our workplace. These unique insights and different perspectives enable us to provide excellent customer service to an equally diverse customer base. With such a diverse workforce, we understand the importance of creating and maintaining an inclusive culture where everyone feels safe and comfortable to be themselves at work. We believe in giving people a go and supporting those who want to drive their careers forward.
